quality.paused: Climate and crop-fit views await verified recent weather. Planning advice may be available in the Plan tab with low confidence; journal and soil values remain available.
quality.advicePending: Advice needs at least 30 consecutive checked years through last December. Data is still being prepared; refresh to resume an interrupted download.
quality.proxySummary: Recent weather could not be verified. Advice uses a historical-weather scenario, not current field conditions.
quality.proxyReason: Checked daily history ends on {{date}}. The model reuses calendar-matched weather from {{year}} for the recent period and replays your journal against that scenario. Soil water, yield and income are estimates, not current observations or forecasts. February 29 uses February 28 when needed. Check local conditions before acting.
quality.scenarioSub: Starting from scenario soil water, tested against {{n}} checked historical weather windows ({{first}}-{{last}}).
quality.savedWarning: This saved result uses unverified or older weather. Recalculate before making a decision.
quality.relativeHelp: Relative to these options, not a measure of safety.
quality.loss: Expected income is below estimated costs.
quality.resetUnavailable: Password-reset email is not configured on this installation. Contact the administrator.
quality.resetDev: Development mode: no email was sent. Reset requests for existing accounts are available only to the local administrator.
quality.resetAccepted: Request accepted. If this account exists, check your email. Delivery is not guaranteed; contact the administrator if no message arrives.
quality.fallow: Recorded fallow is included in the soil-water estimate.
quality.exportStarted: Export requested. Check your browser downloads.

app.name: AuraFarming
app.tagline: Plan resilient crop rotations with 45 years of NASA Earth data.
app.footer: Weather: NASA POWER · Soil: ISRIC SoilGrids · Advice is guidance, not a guarantee.

farms.title: My farms
farms.subtitle: Each farm gets its own climate and soil profile from NASA and soil maps.
farms.emptyText: Add your field's location to download and verify its weather history.

newFarm.title: Add a farm
newFarm.subtitle: Tell us where the field is. We'll download its weather history and soil profile.
newFarm.name: Farm name
newFarm.coordsHint: Decimal degrees. South and west are negative.
newFarm.locationError: Couldn't get your location. Enter the coordinates instead.
newFarm.invalidCoords: Enter a latitude between -90 and 90 and a longitude between -180 and 180.
newFarm.mapTitle: Find your field on the map
newFarm.pinHint: Search for your village, then tap the map where the field is. Drag the pin to adjust.
newFarm.boundaryHint: Tap each corner of the field in order; drag a corner to move it.
newFarm.searchFailed: The place search isn't available right now. Move the map yourself or type the coordinates.
newFarm.noResults: No places found. Try a nearby town.
newFarm.boundaryNeedsThree: Tap at least 3 corners of the field, or switch to dropping a pin.
newFarm.areaFromDrawing: Filled in from the drawing; you can change it.

farm.confirmDelete: Delete this farm and its data? This can't be undone.
farm.buildingText: Downloading and checking NASA POWER weather one year at a time. A new location can take several minutes; completed years are kept if interrupted.
farm.step1: NASA POWER weather and soil moisture, 1981 to today
farm.step2: Soil texture, water holding and carbon (SoilGrids)
farm.errorTitle: We couldn't prepare this farm's data
farm.summaryLoading: Working out what to sow next…
farm.summarySub: The top 3 for your priorities, starting from your soil today.

climate.thisSeasonSub: Compared with the same dates in {{n}} past years
climate.onsetDetail: Typical date. Arrives by 30 Jun in {{odds}}.
climate.falseStartDetail: The first big rain is followed by 10+ dry days. Don't sow on the first rain.
climate.seasonDetail: Typical. Long enough for two rain-fed crops (180+ days) in {{odds}}.
climate.rabiHeatDetail: 5+ days above 35 °C between 15 Feb and 15 Mar. Sow rabi crops early.
climate.deficientDetail: Jun–Sep rain below 75% of normal ({{median}} typical).
climate.windowsDetail: Periods with enough soil water and warmth in most years.
climate.monthly: Rain and water demand by month
climate.monthlySub: Average rain vs reference evapotranspiration (ET0). Where the line is above the bars, crops need stored water or irrigation.
climate.annualSub: Orange years fell below the amount you can count on in 8 of 10 years.
climate.aridityDetail: Rain is {{pct}} of the yearly water demand ({{et0}}).
climate.source: NASA POWER daily data, grid cell {{cell}} (elevation {{elevation}} m), {{first}} to {{until}}. Soil water storage assumed: {{awc}} mm ({{awcSource}}).
climate.onsetRule: First day from 1 Jun when 3-day rain reaches 20 mm, with no 10-day dry spell in the next 30 days

soilNow.assumed: Nothing is logged for {{season}} {{year}}, so the usual {{crop}} crop is assumed. Log what you grew (or that the field was fallow) for a better estimate.
soilNow.bare: No crop is logged since {{date}}, so the field is modelled as bare, which dries only the topsoil.
soilNow.journal: Worked out from the crops in your season journal.
soilNow.reference: Modelled for a crop growing all year round.

soil.unavailable: Soil-map data isn't available for this spot, so a standard soil (100 mm of water storage) is assumed until you enter yours.
soil.saved: Saved. Climate, crop fit and advice now use these soil values.
soil.editSub: If you know your soil better than the soil map, for example from a Soil Health Card, enter it here. Every model will use your values.
soil.presetHint: Typical values filled in; change any you know.
soil.depthLabel: Soil depth (to rock or hard layer)
soil.textureAll: Give sand, silt and clay together, or leave all three empty.
soil.textureSum: Sand, silt and clay add up to {{total}}%; they must add up to 100%.
soil.awcHint: Leave empty to work it out from the texture.
soil.water: Water the soil holds for crops
soil.waterDetail: In the top {{depth}} cm when full ({{perMetre}} mm per metre)
soil.carbonDetail: {{stock}} t C/ha in the top 30 cm
soil.layersSub: The SoilGrids estimate for this spot, layer by layer.
soil.sourceNote: Soil-map values are modelled estimates from ISRIC SoilGrids (250 m); a lab soil test of your field may differ.

history.satelliteSub: Greenness (NDVI) from NASA's MODIS satellite every 16 days since 2000, for the 250 m pixel around your farm.
history.downloading: Downloading satellite history: {{done}} of {{total}} images, newest first
history.slow: NASA's service sends 10 images per request, so the full history takes about 10 minutes. Recent years appear first, and you can keep using the app.
history.legend: Green bands: seasons in your journal. Amber bands: crops the satellite saw that you haven't logged yet. Drag the slider to see earlier years.
history.suggestionsSub: Confirm what you grew so rotation advice can account for it.
history.seenDetail: Green from about {{greenUp}}, greenest on {{peak}}, harvested around {{harvest}}.
history.vigour: Greener than {{pct}} of the {{season}} seasons seen here
history.journalSub: What you grew, when, and how it went. Rotation advice uses this.
history.empty: No seasons logged yet. Add the last 2–3 years so advice can account for what you grew.
history.confirmDelete: Delete this season from your journal?
history.herbicideHint: Some herbicides limit which crops can follow.

crops.title: {{season}} {{year}}: which crops fit this farm
crops.subtitle: Every crop simulated on your soil with the weather of each past season, {{first}}–{{last}} ({{n}} seasons).
crops.noHistory: No earlier crop in your journal yet, so previous-crop effects are left out.
crops.soilNote: Soil holds {{awc}} mm of plant-available water per metre ({{source}}).
crops.carbonBaselineJournal: Soil carbon changes are compared with what your journal shows for the past year.
crops.carbonBaselineDefault: Soil carbon changes are compared with a typical rain-fed maize crop whose residue is removed.
crops.failsDetail: Below half of the {{value}} possible here
crops.byYearSub: {{n}} simulated seasons. Orange seasons fell below half the possible yield.
crops.noHeat: Not a concern for this crop
crops.nitrogenFixer: fixes about {{fixed}} kg N/ha and leaves about {{leaves}} for the next crop
crops.carbonValue: {{kept}} t C/ha with residue left in the field (range {{low}} to {{high}})
crops.carbonRemoved: {{removed}} t C/ha if the residue is removed
crops.drySown: Sown into dry soil in {{k}} of {{n}} seasons (no sowing rain before the window closed).
crops.lateSown: Sown after its window in {{k}} of {{n}} seasons because the field was still occupied.
crops.method: Simulated with the FAO-56 daily soil-water balance, FAO-33 yield response to water deficit, heat at flowering and the RothC soil-carbon model, using NASA POWER weather and SoilGrids soil. Crop parameters are indicative and still need local validation. Guidance, not a guarantee.

rule.sameCrop: Same crop within the last year: about {{pct}}% lower yield
rule.sameCropBlocked: Not advised: {{problems}} hit this crop last time and stays in the soil
rule.sameFamily: {{family}} again soon after {{crop}}: about {{pct}}% lower yield
rule.legumeCredit: {{crop}} left about {{kg}} kg N/ha: use less fertiliser
rule.nLockup: Ploughed-in {{crop}} residue ties up about {{kg}} kg N/ha for a few weeks
rule.residueToxic: {{crop}} residue can stunt small-seeded crops: wait about {{days}} days
rule.herbicide: You used {{herbicide}}: check its label for crops that can follow
rule.herbicideBlocked: Not advised: {{herbicide}} residues injure this crop for about a year
rule.calendar: {{crop}} holds the field until about {{ready}}, after this crop's window closes ({{windowEnd}})
rule.windowPassed: This season's sowing window closed on {{date}}

plan.prioritiesSub: Advice is ranked by what matters to you: 0 = doesn't matter, 5 = matters most.

pillarHelp.income: Average profit and the profit in a bad year
pillarHelp.water: Less irrigation and more crop per drop
pillarHelp.soil: Soil carbon, nitrogen fixed, ground cover, crop variety
pillarHelp.risk: Fewer failed seasons and pest carry-over, a better bad year

flag.pack_unvalidated: crop yields and costs are indicative, and prices are support prices (MSP) or estimates
flag.soil_default: soil water storage is a standard value
flag.no_soil_carbon: there is no soil-carbon data here
flag.short_record: the weather record is shorter than 30 years

plan.nextSub: Starting from your soil today, with the weather that followed this date in {{n}} past years ({{first}}–{{last}}).
plan.pricesSub: Profit = yield × price − cost − fertiliser nitrogen at {{n}} per kg N (subsidised urea).
plan.costNote: MSP is the government's minimum support price (CACP); market prices can be lower or higher. Costs are indicative paid-out costs, not survey figures, so treat profits as a comparison between options.
plan.inField: {{crop}} is still growing; expected harvest around {{date}}.
plan.paretoHelp: No other option beats it on all four priorities

strong.income: One of the most profitable options
strong.water: One of the most water-efficient options
strong.soil: One of the best for soil health

weak.income: One of the least profitable options

plan.blockedTitle: Not advised after your recent crops
plan.unsuitable: Not ranked because they fail in at least 9 of 10 past years from today's soil: {{crops}}.
plan.hardSeason: A hard season: even the top option fails {{odds}} from today's soil. Compare with protective irrigation, or leave the field fallow to save soil water for the next crop.
plan.noOptions: No crop is likely to succeed this season from today's soil: every option fails in at least 9 of 10 past years. Try protective irrigation or another season, or leave the field fallow to save soil water.
plan.stressSub: Do the top options hold up in a hotter or drier future? Each cell shows the rank among the options tested and the typical profit.
plan.robustHelp: Stays in the top 3 in every scenario
plan.rotationsSub: {{rotations}} rotations built from {{patterns}} cropping patterns, each tested on {{n}} pairs of past years.
plan.currentJournal: From your season journal, repeated for two years.
plan.currentDefault: Assumed: one rain-fed maize crop a year with its residue removed. Log your seasons to compare with what you really do.
plan.vsCurrent: Compared with now: {{income}} a year · {{carbon}} t C/ha of soil carbon
plan.compareHint: Tick up to 3 options to compare them.
plan.savedEmpty: No saved plans yet. Save an option from the advice to keep it here.
plan.disclaimer: Simulated outcomes from NASA weather, soil maps and indicative crop, price and cost data. Use them to compare options, not as a guarantee. AuraFarming gives no pesticide advice.
